==={{header|FreeBASIC}}===
<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">#Ifdef __FB_WIN32__
    #include "windows.bi"
#EndIf

Type Sparkline
    #Ifdef __fb_win32__
        charsetW As WString Ptr
    #Else
        charset As String
    #EndIf
    Declare Constructor()
    Declare Constructor(cs As Any Ptr)
    Declare Sub imprimir(spark As String)
End Type

'  Windows Implementation
#Ifdef __FB_WIN32__
    ' --- Actual Unicode output with WriteConsoleW ---
    Private Sub PrintW(s As WString)
        Dim As HANDLE h = GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE)
        Dim As DWORD written
        WriteConsoleW(h, Strptr(s), Len(s), @written, NULL)
    End Sub
    
    ' Default constructor: uses Unicode blocks
    Constructor Sparkline()
        Static As WString * 8 charsetDef = Wchr(&H2581) & Wchr(&H2582) & Wchr(&H2583) & _
		Wchr(&H2584) & Wchr(&H2585) & Wchr(&H2586) & Wchr(&H2587) & Wchr(&H2588)
        charsetW = @charsetDef
    End Constructor
    
    ' Constructor with external charset (WString Ptr)
    Constructor Sparkline(cs As Any Ptr)
        charsetW = Cptr(WString Ptr, cs)
    End Constructor

'  Linux Implementation
#Else
    ' Default constructor
    Constructor Sparkline()
        ' Linux: Native UTF-8, Unicode blocks
        charset = "▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█"
    End Constructor
    
    ' Constructor with external charset (String Ptr)
    Constructor Sparkline(cs As Any Ptr)
        charset = *Cptr(String Ptr, cs)
    End Constructor
#EndIf

Sub Sparkline.imprimir(spark As String)
	Dim As Double dato(200)
	Dim As Integer i, datoCant = 0
	
	Dim As String tmp = ""
	For i = 1 To Len(spark)
		Dim As String c = Mid(spark, i, 1)
		If (c >= "0" And c <= "9") Or c = "." Or c = "-" Then
			tmp &= c
		Elseif Len(tmp) > 0 Then
			dato(datoCant) = Val(tmp)
			datoCant += 1
			tmp = ""
		End If
	Next
	If Len(tmp) > 0 Then
		dato(datoCant) = Val(tmp)
		datoCant += 1
	End If
	If datoCant = 0 Then Exit Sub
	
	Dim As Double minVal = dato(0), maxVal = dato(0)
	For i = 1 To datoCant - 1
		If dato(i) < minVal Then minVal = dato(i)
		If dato(i) > maxVal Then maxVal = dato(i)
	Next
	
	Dim As Integer charsetLen = Len(*charsetW)
	Dim As Double range = maxVal - minVal
	If range = 0 Then range = 1
	
	Dim As WString * 200 linea
	linea = "Min: " & Str(minVal) & ",  Max: " & Str(maxVal) & ",  Range: " & Str(range)
	PrintW(linea & !"\n")
	
	For i = 0 To datoCant - 1
		Dim As Integer idx = Int(((dato(i) - minVal) / range) * (charsetLen - 1))
		If idx < 0 Then idx = 0
		If idx >= charsetLen Then idx = charsetLen - 1
		
		Dim As WString * 2 ch = Mid(*charsetW, idx + 1, 1)
		PrintW(ch)
	Next
	
	PrintW(!"\n\n")
End Sub
	
' Main program
Dim sl As Sparkline
sl.imprimir("1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 7 6 5 4 3 2 1")
sl.imprimir("1.5, 0.5 3.5, 2.5 5.5, 4.5 7.5, 6.5")
sl.imprimir("0 1 19 20")

Sleep</syntaxhighlight>

<pre>Min: 1,  Max: 8,  Range: 7
▁▁▂▃▄▅▆▇▆▅▄▃▂▁▁

Min: 0.5,  Max: 7.5,  Range: 7
▁▁▃▂▅▄▇▆

Min: 0,  Max: 20,  Range: 20
▁▁▆▇</pre>
